Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: one individual full-body transparent Buddy image frame for a mobile Friend Card.
Image 1 is the PRIMARY identity reference, the original buddy_master.png. Preserve this exact mascot, not a generic purple bear: same enormous soft wide lavender head, very small chubby seated torso, short round limbs, round ears with pink inner cups, dense short plush fur, glossy black eyes and reference catchlights, pink blush, dark-purple D smile with pink tongue. Same head/body ratio, same soft studio lighting, lavender/pink palette and plush detail. No eyebrows, nose, star, human fingers, teeth, clothing, logos or other characters. Three round toe beans plus a heart pad on each foot; four beans plus heart pad only if a palm is visible.
Composition: full seated Buddy, near-front camera like master, both feet on the same horizontal baseline, head centered, 8% safe empty padding all sides, 1024x1024. No ears, paws or props clipped. True alpha transparency including soft fur edges, no white backdrop, no ground plane or drop shadow. Do not include any text, symbols, numbers, selected colour, name, watermark, border or label. Cards/badge must be plain blank warm cream.
Only change the pose described below.
Pose: Buddy quietly listens to a parent entering a child's name. Both furry paws gently clasp together in front of the upper tummy. Head tips just slightly forward; both OPEN glossy eyes clearly look DOWN toward an input below the image, not at the viewer. Small warm gentle D-shaped smile; attentive, happy and calm, never worried or sleepy. No prop.
